title: How a constellation takes shape — bounded visual proof

model.earthFixedTransform: TEME to ECF via GMST; world = (x, z, -y) / 6378.137
model.sampleMode: Direct propagation from a fresh copy of the frozen baseline at each displayed UTC; no interpolation.

rights.attribution: CelesTrak standard GP; USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron via Space-Track.org.
rights.fields: Basic GP/OMM fields only. OneWeb group membership and names are provider-supplied. No optional status, availability or service metadata.
rights.changes: NORAD identities normalized to decimal strings; UTC suffix and documented Earth/TEME/UTC/SGP4 defaults explicit; per-object age bounds added.

selection: Every valid, age-eligible identity from one retained CelesTrak OneWeb standard GP group. No visual cap; no active-service or complete-constellation claim.

presentation.sequence: One satellite, one measured orientation neighbourhood, all eligible retained identities. Authored reveal at one continuously advancing model UTC; not a deployment history.
presentation.plane: At initial UTC, select the densest 1-degree angular-momentum-normal neighbourhood among near-circular main-shell records (108–111 minute mean period; eccentricity <0.003). Break ties by smallest numeric NORAD identity. All initially eligible records within 1 degree of its normal form the featured neighbourhood; no operator plane identifiers are inferred.
presentation.guides: Optional circular orientation diagrams at sampled radii, using propagated angular-momentum normals. Not observed tracks, trajectories, coverage footprints or communications links.
presentation.frame: Earth-fixed display. Direct SGP4 states; positions, orientation guides, inspection and UTC share the same instant.
presentation.scope: The proof ends at the whole-population reveal. Coverage modelling and ground-location controls remain later work.

featured.name: ONEWEB-0026
featured.frame: Propagated TEME angular-momentum normal at initial study UTC.

validation.sampling: Every retained identity propagated every 30 seconds within its eligibility interval; independent cases at first, middle and last eligible UTC.

independentAgreement.implementation: Python sgp4 2.25 / Vallado C++ plus independent GMST/ECF transform
independentAgreement.epochPrecision: Source fractional epochs retained; both propagations use JavaScript millisecond precision.
independentAgreement.limitation: Independent numerical agreement; not a measurement of element accuracy or service availability.

browserMeasurement.method: Production preview, complete population, 300x direct propagation, 120 real rAF samples after load with first 11 omitted, ten direct seeks. Sampling/UI timing excludes the subsequent draw; rAF gaps measure scheduler cadence; model-frame gaps measure changed UTC on rendered updates (the app targets about 30 Hz). Two engines measured sequentially. No virtual clock.
browserMeasurement.limitation: Local headless desktop and phone emulation only; hardware model and physical phone not measured. This is a bounded local check, not a sustained physical-device frame-rate claim.

results.label: Headless WebKit iPhone 13 emulation (not a physical phone)

validation.browser: 186 browser checks pass across Chromium, mobile WebKit and the existing desktop WebKit raster case. New chapter checks cover the three-stage reveal, record/UTC agreement, deterministic seeking, eligibility, reduced motion, native controls, portrait/landscape, corruption recovery, Discover and /zenit/ relative assets.
